channel.title: Middle East AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Israel/Gaza, Iran, Syria, Lebanon and Iraq developments

item.title: Flydubai flight to Tel Aviv veers off course, lands in Saudi Arabia after hijacking scare
item.description: Mid-air altercation between the aircraft's pilots triggered emergency code, sparking hijacking fears and raising alarms in Israel • More than 100 Israeli passengers were on board

item.title: Iran is renewing progress on its nuclear program, Netanyahu tells UAE President MBZ - report
item.description: According to the report, the information Netanyahu presented included details about new construction work at the mountainous site known as “Pickaxe Mountain,” about 140 miles south of Tehran.

item.title: Israel's peculiar state of affairs: Arab nations friendlier, Europe's relations fall - editorial
item.description: There is something deeply strange about an Israel increasingly able to discuss its future with Arab and Muslim states while European nations grow increasingly hostile.

item.title: U2 frontman Bono compares Ben-Gvir comments on Gazans to Nazi leader Heinrich Himmler's rhetoric
item.description: During the interview, conducted by journalist Brian Hiatt, Bono addressed comments Ben-Gvir made about Gaza residents in a conversation with former hostage survivor Rom Braslavski.

item.title: Thousands of Christians visit West Bank settlements in support after European sanctions, trade bans
item.description: "The laws enacted in Europe against purchasing products from Jewish communities in Judea and Samaria are antisemitism, pure and simple," a Norwegian Christian leader said.

item.title: Trump says Iran 'will give up,' compares its nuclear ambitions with North Korea
item.description: Speaking after a tech moguls' luncheon, Trump criticized Britain over suspects released on bail near a US-used airbase, discussed his meeting with China's Xi Jinping, and debated the future of AI.

item.title: US Senate blocks measure demanding report on rising violence in West Bank
item.description: The Senate voted 47 to 51 to block the resolution. The vote was largely along party lines, with every Republican voting no except for Rand Paul and every Democrat voting yes except for John Fetterman

item.title: No. 1: Jared Kushner and Ivanka Trump: Remembering who brought the hostages home
item.description: Jared Kushner and Ivanka Trump helped achieve what few in Jerusalem thought possible, bringing every Israeli hostage home and reshaping the Middle East.

item.title: No. 3: Gadi Eisenkot: Israel’s next prime minister?
item.description: The former IDF chief has emerged as the leading opposition challenger to Netanyahu, offering voters a path to a post-Netanyahu Israel.

item.title: No. 4: Naftali Bennett: The former PM seeking a comeback to ‘repair Israel’
item.description: Since returning to politics, Bennett has shifted from his previous campaigns, taking a more liberal position while maintaining a strong right-wing stance on security.

item.title: No. 5: Ronald Lauder: Standing at the forefront of the fight against antisemitism
item.description: Lauder has never confined himself to quiet philanthropy - he continues to use his position to demand accountability from political leaders.

item.title: No. 2: Benjamin Netanyahu: Shaping Israel’s politics and global image for a generation
item.description: Netanyahu has become more than Israel’s prime minister for many. Abroad, for instance, he has become Israel’s symbol and the lightning rod for much of the hatred directed against the Jewish state.

item.title: Hamas official's arrest in Gaza gave Israel intelligence surge to kill top terrorists - exclusive
item.description: Three Hamas brigade commanders have been killed since September 11, following the September 2 capture of senior Hamas security official Mu'in al-Arabid in Gaza.

item.title: Israel axes aliyah approval for Jewish activists involved in pro-Palestinian advocacy - interview
item.description: The Population and Immigration Authority overturned the aliyah approvals of two activists in their 20s, who have worked with Palestinian communities in the West Bank.

item.title: Lapid: No need for public panic, despite Netanyahu's claims of possible pre-election attack
item.description: "Security threats must be handled professionally and responsibly," Lapid said. "Israel’s security and IDF bases are not mere backdrops for election campaign videos."

item.title: Hind Rajab Foundation files complaint in Vietnam against IDF reservist vacationer
item.description: The Belgium-based organization, which has pursued IDF soldiers traveling abroad after serving in Gaza and Lebanon, filed the complaint against H.G., a young Israeli.

item.title: IDF keeps killing Hamas commanders, but their units were already defeated in Gaza - analysis
item.description: The IDF has repeatedly declared Hamas units defeated, yet commanders of those same units continue to emerge and be targeted, raising questions about Hamas’s ability to rebuild its forces.

item.title: Jewish TV star Adam Brody calls Israeli actions in Gaza ‘genocide’
item.description: The Jewish actor and star of 'Nobody Wants This' told GQ that he believes Israel's actions in Gaza are 'genocide,' and also says he's observed growing conservative beliefs in Hollywood circles.

item.title: Trump calls Kim Jong Un a ‘friend’ and plays down N Korea’s nuclear arsenal
item.description: US president's comments came after he was asked why North Korea can have nuclear weapons when Iran cannot.

item.title: Israel’s Lapid accuses Netanyahu of ‘fear-mongering’ over attack warning
item.description: Opposition leader dismisses Netanyahu's warning of possible attacks during next month's general election.
